proposed_highlights: USPA-certified instructors with professional training provide safety oversight and guidance for your entire tandem skydive experience
Freefall from 14,000 feet with breathtaking panoramic views of the Chicago skyline and Lake Michigan shoreline
[Example — verify with merchant:] Minimum age 18 years — all jumpers must meet height and weight requirements per facility chart

Since competitor research failed to find actual skydiving pricing (only boat tours), the merchant must verify typical market rates. The research synthesis notes "typical industry pricing ($150–$300 range)" but without high-confidence sources, this must be confirmed. If unable to verify competitor pricing, reframe around value delivered: "3-hour experience including training, scenic flight, freefall, and parachute ride — all equipment and USPA-certified instructor included in $210." executive_summary: The page scores 6.3/10 overall but has a critical value communication gap (4/10): customers see $210 with zero context — no original price, no market comparison, no savings anchor. The #2 issue is missing category-critical safety info: minimum age, health restrictions, and weather policy are nowhere to be found despite 8 identified content gaps. Adding market context ("Typical tandem jumps $225–$300") and filling the top 3 content gaps (age, health, weather) could lift conversion 18–28%.

recommendations.short_title: Add health and medical restrictions section
recommendations.recommendation: Add a 'Health & Safety Requirements' section to the fine print or 'What To Expect' area listing medical restrictions for skydiving. Proposed section: '[Example — verify with merchant:] Not recommended for guests who are pregnant or have heart conditions, recent surgeries, back or neck problems, seizure disorders, or other serious medical conditions. Consult your physician if you have health concerns. By signing the waiver you confirm you are physically fit to skydive.' This manages expectations and reduces post-purchase cancellations.
recommendations.current_state: Zero health or medical restrictions mentioned anywhere on the page. Page lists weight limits and ID requirements but is silent on heart conditions, pregnancy, recent surgery, or other common skydiving exclusions. Customer with pacemaker has no way to know if they're eligible.

Health & Safety Requirements:
